title: IRS arrest warrant, gift cards
label: scam
lines: This is Officer Daniels with the IRS Criminal Division.
There is a warrant for your arrest over unpaid taxes.
You can settle this today if you pay with gift cards.
Do not tell your bank, they will freeze the case.

title: IRS back taxes, wire transfer
label: scam
lines: This is the Internal Revenue Service enforcement office.
You owe four thousand two hundred dollars in back taxes.
Wire it within two hours or deputies will come to your home.

title: Social Security number suspended
label: scam
lines: This is the Social Security Administration.
Your Social Security number has been suspended because of suspicious activity.
Confirm your number now or your benefits will be cancelled today.

title: Medicare card replacement
label: scam
lines: We are issuing new Medicare cards this month.
To send yours, please confirm your Medicare number and your bank account.

title: Missed jury duty fine
label: scam
lines: This is the court clerk's office. You missed jury duty and a warrant was issued.
You can clear it today with a fine of fifteen hundred dollars on prepaid cards.
Please do not discuss this with anyone until it is cleared.

title: County clerk civil filing, gift cards
label: scam
lines: This is the county clerk's office. There is a civil filing in your name.
It has to be settled today or the filing goes forward.
You need to buy gift cards and read me the codes on the back.
Do not tell your bank, and do not talk to your family until the codes are in.

title: Customs package seized
label: scam
lines: This is U.S. Customs and Border Protection.
A package in your name was seized with illegal items inside.
Pay a nine hundred dollar release fee in Bitcoin today or you will be arrested.

title: Immigration file problem
label: scam
lines: This is the immigration services office.
There is a problem with your file that must be corrected today.
Send the correction fee by money transfer or your status may be cancelled.

title: Utility shutoff threat
label: scam
lines: Billing department at your power company.
Your account is sixty days past due and service will be shut off in thirty minutes.
Pay now with a prepaid card or a cash app, we cannot take a regular payment.

title: Unpaid toll, press to pay
label: scam
lines: Your toll account balance is overdue.
Pay twelve dollars fifty today to avoid fines. Press 1 to pay now.

title: Student loan forgiveness fee
label: scam
lines: You qualify for federal student loan forgiveness.
There is a one-time processing fee of two ninety-nine, and you must enroll by Friday.
Pay it by wire, and do not call your loan servicer. They will try to talk you out of it.

title: Government grant fee, gift cards
label: scam
lines: Congratulations, you have been awarded a nine thousand dollar government grant.
To release it, send two hundred fifty dollars in gift cards for the processing fee.
Keep this confidential until the funds clear.

title: Tax refund and text code
label: scam
lines: You are owed a two thousand dollar tax refund.
To deposit it I need your bank login, and the code we are about to text you.
Read it to me as soon as it arrives.

title: Disaster relief confirmation
label: scam
lines: This is the disaster relief assistance line.
Your claim closes today unless you confirm your Social Security number and bank account.

title: Bank fraud, move to a safe account
label: scam
lines: This is your bank's fraud department.
Someone is draining your account right now.
Move your savings to this secure account immediately.
Do not tell the branch staff, one of them may be involved.

title: Read me the verification code
label: scam
lines: We flagged a fraudulent charge on your card.
We just texted you a verification code.
Read it to me so I can block the charge.

title: Compromised card, read the numbers
label: scam
lines: Your card ending in 4410 was used in another state.
To cancel it right now, read me the full card number, the expiration date, and the three digits on the back.

title: Interest rate reduction robocall
label: scam
lines: Press 1 to lower your credit card interest rate to three point nine percent.
We only need your card number to verify your account.

title: Mistaken Zelle transfer
label: scam
lines: Hi, I accidentally sent you eight hundred dollars on Zelle.
I am in a tough spot. Can you send it back to this number right now?

title: Guaranteed crypto returns
label: scam
lines: Our platform guarantees forty percent weekly returns.
Deposit in Bitcoin today because the offer closes tonight.
Do not mention it to your financial advisor, they will only talk you out of it.

title: Trading-app long con
label: scam
lines: My uncle's trading app doubled my savings, and I want you to have the same.
Transfer your funds to the platform in USDT before the window closes tomorrow.
Do not tell your family, they will not understand.

title: Advance-fee loan, gift cards
label: scam
lines: Your fifteen thousand dollar loan is approved.
Before we release it, pay a five hundred dollar insurance fee with gift cards.

title: Debt collector threat
label: scam
lines: This is a final notice from the legal department about a payday loan.
Pay seven hundred eighty dollars today by prepaid card or we will file suit and call your employer.

title: Credit repair upfront fee
label: scam
lines: We can erase your bad credit.
Pay twelve hundred dollars up front by wire and we will start working on it.

title: Bank detective cash handoff
label: scam
lines: I am a detective working with your bank on an internal fraud case.
Withdraw nine thousand dollars in cash today and hand it to my agent.
If the teller asks, tell them it is for a home repair.

title: Check overpayment refund
label: scam
lines: My company sent you a check for three thousand dollars too much.
Deposit it and wire me the difference today.

title: Vendor changed bank account
label: scam
lines: This is Dana from accounting at your supplier.
We changed banks. Send the next invoice payment to the new account today.
Please keep this between us until the audit is done.

title: Boss needs gift cards
label: scam
lines: It is your manager. I am stuck in a meeting and cannot talk.
I need ten hundred-dollar gift cards for clients, and send me the codes.
Keep this quiet for now.

title: Windows virus, remote access
label: scam
lines: This is Microsoft Windows support.
Your computer is sending out viruses.
Download this tool so I can take control of your screen, or your files will be deleted today.

title: Refund through remote access
label: scam
lines: Your antivirus plan renewed for three ninety-nine.
To refund you, I need remote access to your bank page.
Do not tell the bank, they will cancel the refund.

title: Apple ID locked, read the code
label: scam
lines: Your Apple ID has been locked.
Read me the six-digit code Apple just sent so I can unlock it.

title: Internet provider says router hacked
label: scam
lines: Your internet provider detected hackers on your router.
Give me your router password so I can secure it today.

title: Unauthorized Amazon order
label: scam
lines: Amazon fraud team. A twelve ninety-nine phone order is about to ship.
Install this app so we can see your screen and cancel it, or the charge goes through.

title: PayPal charge dispute
label: scam
lines: PayPal security: a four ninety-nine charge to an unknown merchant.
Press 1 to dispute, then enter your login right away to confirm it is you.

title: Subscription renewal callback bait
label: scam
lines: Your computer support plan renews today for three forty-nine.
Call this number before midnight to cancel.

title: Listing verification code
label: scam
lines: Hi, I am calling about your listing.
I am sending a code to prove you are real, so read it back to me.

title: Bitcoin ATM deposit
label: scam
lines: Your accounts are compromised.
Withdraw your cash right away and deposit it into the Bitcoin machine at the gas station.
Stay on the phone and do not tell the clerk why.

title: Crypto wallet recovery phrase
label: scam
lines: This is wallet support. Your funds are at risk.
Read me your twelve-word recovery phrase so I can move them to a safe wallet.
Do not share this with anyone, including friends.

title: Phone carrier PIN and code
label: scam
lines: Your mobile carrier here. You qualify for a free upgrade.
To confirm, tell me your account PIN and the code we are texting you.

title: Package redelivery fee
label: scam
lines: Your parcel is being held at the depot.
Pay a two ninety-nine redelivery fee now and give me your card number.

title: Grandparent in jail
label: scam
lines: Grandma, it is me. I am in jail and need bail money.
Please do not tell Mom and Dad.
A lawyer will call, then a courier will pick up the cash today.

title: Fake kidnapping
label: scam
lines: We have your daughter.
Wire five thousand dollars now or you will never see her.
Do not hang up and do not call the police.

title: Hospital card deposit
label: scam
lines: I am a nurse at the county hospital. Your brother was in a car accident.
He needs surgery and we need a card deposit over the phone right now.

title: New number, gift cards
label: scam
lines: Mom, I dropped my phone in water. This is my new number.
Can you buy a few gift cards and text me the codes? Do not tell Dad yet.

title: Voice-clone emergency
label: scam
lines: Dad, I was in a wreck and I need money for a lawyer right now.
Please send it in crypto and do not tell Mom.

title: Friend robbed abroad
label: scam
lines: I got robbed in Madrid and my passport is gone.
Wire me eighteen hundred dollars today, I will pay you back. Keep it between us.

title: Deployed partner, gift cards
label: scam
lines: I ship out tomorrow and the leave papers cost fifteen hundred dollars.
The base store only takes gift cards, so please send the codes.

title: Romance medical emergency
label: scam
lines: My daughter needs surgery tonight.
Please wire the money, and do not tell your family. They will only doubt me.

title: Travel clearance fee
label: scam
lines: I bought my ticket to visit you, but customs needs a six hundred dollar clearance fee.
Send it by MoneyGram today so I can board.

title: Lottery taxes
label: scam
lines: Congratulations, you won seven hundred fifty thousand dollars in the international lottery.
To release it, wire nine fifty for taxes within twenty-four hours.
Keep it private so no one else can claim it.

title: Timeshare resale fee
label: scam
lines: I have a buyer for your timeshare at eighteen thousand dollars.
Wire a one thousand dollar closing fee today.

title: Fake veterans charity
label: scam
lines: Please donate to disabled veterans today.
The easiest way is gift cards. You can read me the numbers right now.

title: Sweepstakes handling fee
label: scam
lines: This is the prize patrol. You won five million dollars.
First, pay a handling fee with prepaid cards and do not tell anyone until we arrive.

title: Car warranty robocall
label: scam
lines: We have been trying to reach you about your car's extended warranty.
Press 1 now, your coverage expires today.

title: Roofing deposit
label: scam
lines: I am the roofer from next door and I saw damage to your roof.
Send a two thousand dollar deposit by Zelle today and I will start tomorrow.

title: Free medical alert device
label: scam
lines: Your family ordered you a free medical alert system.
Just confirm your credit card for shipping.

title: Insurance enrollment deadline
label: scam
lines: Medicare enrollment closes today.
Give me your Medicare number and bank details to keep your coverage.

title: Mystery shopper gift cards
label: scam
lines: You have been selected as a mystery shopper.
Buy two two-hundred-dollar gift cards, scratch off the backs, and read me the numbers.
We will reimburse you by check.

title: Equipment check job offer
label: scam
lines: Congratulations on the job!
We will send a check to buy your home-office equipment.
Deposit it, then wire the vendor two thousand dollars this week.

title: Landlord out of the country
label: scam
lines: The apartment is available but I am out of the country.
Wire the deposit today to hold it before someone else takes it.

title: Payroll onboarding data
label: scam
lines: Welcome aboard. To set up payroll, send me your Social Security number and bank details today.

title: Gold bars for safekeeping
label: scam
lines: This is the federal fraud unit. Hackers are targeting your accounts.
Convert your savings into gold bars, and an agent will collect them and keep them safe.
Tell no one, not even the bank, and do it today.

title: Friendly wrong-number opener
label: scam
lines: Hi Jamie? Sorry, I think I have the wrong number.
You sound really nice though, how is your day going?

title: Callback-bait voicemail
label: scam
lines: This is Deputy Marsh. A case has been filed in your name.
Call 555-0100 immediately.

title: Clinic confirms an appointment
label: benign
lines: Hi, this is the clinic confirming your appointment tomorrow at two.
Please call us back if you need to reschedule.

title: Doctor calling from a personal line
label: benign
lines: Hi, this is Dr. Patel. I am calling from my cell, so the number may look different.
I wanted to confirm your visit tomorrow. You can reach the office at its main line.
note: Caller ID mismatch alone must never raise an alert.

title: Pharmacy order ready
label: benign
lines: Your prescription is ready for pickup.
The pharmacy is open until nine tonight.
note: Time pressure words without a demand.

title: Business toll-free callback
label: benign
lines: This is about your recent order.
If you would like to talk, call our toll-free number on your receipt.

title: Real bank alert, no code request
label: benign
lines: This is a courtesy alert from your bank about a recent charge.
We will never ask for a code. If it is not yours, call the number on the back of your card.
note: Mentions codes and card, but asks for nothing.

title: Birthday gift cards
label: benign
lines: I bought gift cards for Grandma's birthday.
Which store does she like best?

title: Recounting a past scam
label: benign
lines: Last week someone called pretending to be the IRS and asked for gift cards.
I hung up, but it was scary.

title: Delivery code notification
label: benign
lines: Your driver will ask for the code in your confirmation text when the package arrives.
note: Code mentioned, not demanded by the caller.

title: Water bill reminder
label: benign
lines: This is a reminder that your water bill is due Friday.
You can pay on our official website or by mail. No need to call.
note: Billing reminder pointing to an official portal.

title: School closure robocall
label: benign
lines: This is the school district. Classes are closed tomorrow because of weather.
